spans.s: वैण, i. e. वेनु + अ (anomal.), m. A cutter of bambu, a worker in bambuwork,

वैणव, i. e. वेणु + अ,
 I. adj., f. वी, Made of bambu,

.
 II. m.
 1. A bambu-staff.
 2. A worker in bambu or wicker-work.
वैणविक, i. e. वेणु + इक, m. A player on a flute.
वैणिक, i. e. वीणा + इक, m. A lutist.
वैणुक, i. e. वेणु + क, n. A bambu pike, headed with iron, used to drive an elephant.
वैण्य, i. e. वेण + य, patronym., m. The son of Veṇa, Pañc. iii. d. 269.
